title: Universal Sample-Based Embeddings of Higher-Order Objects
abstract: arXiv:2610.19899v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural networks operate naturally on finite-dimensional vectors, yet many problems require reasoning about higher-order objects such as distributions, functions, and graphs. Such objects capture relationships within a ground set and rarely admit an explicit compact representation. Moreover, we typically want a compact representation not of a single higher-order object but of an entire family of such objects, including members unseen during training. While a few approaches exist for particular object types, none is designed to work across object types. We propose a unified framework that represents any higher-order object as a fixed-size embedding vector learned over a family of such objects. An encoder maps an object, seen only through a finite set of samples, to an embedding, and a domain-specific decoder supplies the training signal by modeling the object conditioned on that embedding. translated_title: 高阶对象的通用样本嵌入方法
translated_abstract: 神经网络天然地作用于有限维向量，然而许多问题需要对分布、函数和图等高阶对象进行推理。这类对象刻画了基础集合内部的关系，且很少具备显式的紧凑表示。此外，我们通常希望得到的不是单个高阶对象的紧凑表示，而是整族此类对象的紧凑表示，其中包括训练时未曾见过的对象成员。虽然针对特定对象类型已有一些方法，但目前还没有一种方法被设计为能够跨对象类型通用。我们提出了一个统一框架，将任意高阶对象表示为在该对象族上学到的固定大小嵌入向量。编码器将仅通过有限样本集观察到的对象映射为嵌入向量，而特定领域的解码器则通过在该嵌入条件下对对象进行建模来提供训练信号。由于编码器仅从样本出发进行工作，（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了一个统一的基于样本的嵌入框架，能将分布、函数、图等任意高阶对象编码为固定大小的向量，实现跨对象类型的通用紧凑表示，并可用于训练中未见过的对象。
en_tdlr: Proposes a unified sample-based embedding framework that encodes arbitrary higher-order objects (distributions, functions, graphs) into fixed-size vectors, enabling universal compact representations across object types, including unseen ones.
